summary: Completed comprehensive testing of MongoDB GridFS audio storage feature for Summary Boss app. All 14 backend API tests passed (100%). GridFS collections (audio_files.files and audio_files.chunks) are properly created and storing audio files.
passed_tests: POST /api/meetings/{id}/upload stores audio in GridFS and returns file_id (24-char ObjectId)
Meeting document contains audio_file_id field after upload
Meeting status updates to 'uploaded' after audio upload
Upload endpoint requires authentication (401 without auth)
Upload endpoint rejects invalid file types (400 for non-audio)
GET /api/meetings/{id}/audio streams audio from GridFS with correct content-type
Audio streaming includes Content-Disposition header with filename
Audio streaming requires authentication (401 without auth)
Audio streaming for non-existent meeting returns 404
Audio streaming for meeting without audio returns 404
POST /api/meetings/process stores audio in GridFS during processing
Process endpoint requires authentication (401 without auth)
Meeting model includes audio_file_id field (empty string for new meetings)
Meeting list includes audio_file_id for meetings with audio
Uploading new audio replaces old audio (new file_id generated)
critical_code_review_comments: GridFS bucket correctly initialized with 'audio_files' bucket name
Old audio files are properly deleted when new audio is uploaded (line 1070-1074 in server.py)
Audio streaming uses 1MB chunks for efficient memory usage
Metadata properly stored with each GridFS file (user_id, meeting_id, content_type, original_filename)
seed_data_creation: Test user created, test meetings created and cleaned up during tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: GridFS audio storage feature fully tested and working. Audio files are stored in MongoDB GridFS (audio_files bucket) instead of local filesystem. The audio_file_id field is properly populated in meeting documents. Audio streaming endpoint returns correct content-type and supports streaming playback. Frontend MeetingDetails.jsx has audio player component that appears when audio_file_id exists.
